text:
ashley: quick heads up — community rust sample app failing on auth refresh in a way that blocks new users. minimal repro attached, happens intermittently after 2nd token refresh attempt.

ashley: repro (local):
```bash
# hits /refresh -> 401, server returns no body but sets header X-Retryable: false
curl -i -X POST https://auth.example/refresh -d '{"refresh_token":"abc"}'
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
X-Retryable: false
WWW-Authenticate: error="invalid_token"
```

ashley: rust-sdk behavior: client classifies this as terminal and surfaces plain error to user. ruby-sdk will try one more refresh attempt then fall back to interactive, which feels friendlier for onboarding.

sam: hmm. we changed auth retry classification last quarter to avoid infinite loops. ruby kept implicit extra-attempt behavior.

sam: can you paste the client config? is max_retries set?

ashley: default config, no overrides. snippet from example: `Client::new().with_auto_refresh(true).build()`

ci-bot: CI: build 1876549950 — examples/auth-refresh-rs failed (exit 1)

maya: low-friction onboarding hit. ruby parity here would be nice but i'm wary of reintroducing silent retries. maybe treat 401 + X-Retryable: true as retriable, otherwise bubble with clearer message.

luis: i can open a tiny PR to adjust error classification and add a unit test for the example flow. propose: if 401 and we haven't tried refresh in the current request lifecycle -> mark retriable and attempt refresh, else terminal. keeps guardrails.

ashley: that sounds perfect. also can we improve the sample app error text to include next steps (re-run login flow) so developers don't stare at cryptic 401.

sam: agree on both. luis — if you add a flag to the error type (RetriableAuth) we can map it in ruby and rust consistently. want the patch to the shared auth crate?

luis: yes, i'll target the auth-core crate and add changelog note. will ping for a quick review.

ashley: thanks! saved onboarding pain. :thumbsup:

maya: great. add an integration test that simulates server returning X-Retryable: false and ensure we don't retry infinitely. :eyes:

luis: will do, PR incoming in ~30m.

ashley: tagging internal doc request — devex: could we add a short paragraph in SDK parity guide about this specific 401 handling difference? small note on behavior guarantees during token refresh.

sam: yup, i'll add an entry.

ashley: thanks all — will rerun CI once the PR lands.
